notShown.title: Waxa aan halkan lagu muujin
notShown.body: FursadHub weligeed maamule ma tuso furaha sirta ah, lambarka la qariyay, ama wax calaamad ah — sidaas awgeed midna boggan kama muuqdo.
notShown.memberships: Xubinnimada jaamacadda iyo hay’adda waxaa maamula maamulaha kooxda, oo lagama heli karo hal meel oo guud.

privacyRequests.title: Codsiyada asturnaanta
privacyRequests.description: Codsi kasta waxaa gacanta ku haya qof. Diiwaangelinta natiijada halkan keligeed waxba ma tirtirto mana soo saarto.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Marka la diidayo codsi waxaa loo baahan yahay sabab.

legalDocuments.title: Dukumentiyada sharciga
legalDocuments.description: Dukumentiyadu waxay leeyihiin noocyo. Nooc la daabacay waligiis lama beddeli karo — halkii, daabac nooc cusub.
legalDocuments.immutableNotice: Marka la daabaco, nooca lama beddeli karo lamana tirtiri karo. Saxidda waxay u baahan tahay nooc cusub.
legalDocuments.empty: Weli lama daabicin dukumenti sharci ah.

errors.generic: Dukumentiga lama daabici karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
errors.LEGAL_DOCUMENT_VERSION_EXISTS: Nooca ayaa hore ugu jira luqaddan. Isticmaal lambar nooc oo cusub.

audit.title: Raadraaca hanti-dhawrka
audit.description: Diiwaan joogto ah oo lagu daro oo keliya, oo ah ficillada amniga iyo ganacsiga. Lama beddeli karo lamana tirtiri karo.
audit.empty: Ma jiraan dhacdooyin ku habboon miirayaashan.
audit.invalidRange: Taariikhda bilowga waa inay ka horreysaa tan dhammaadka.
audit.emptyHint: Ma jirto dhacdo la diiwaangeliyay oo ku habboon shaandhadan.

platformRoles.title: Doorarka madasha
platformRoles.description: Doorarka madasha waxaa la siiyaa akoonno gaar ah, waqti kastana waa laga qaadi karaa. Doorarka la qaaday waxay ku sii jiraan liiska taariikhda ahaan.
platformRoles.userIdPlaceholder: Ku dheji aqoonsiga akoonka ee bogga Akoonnada

errors.generic: Tallaabadaas lama dhammayn karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
errors.USER_NOT_ACTIVE: Akoon firfircoon oo keliya ayaa la siin karaa door madasha.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: Maamulaha sare ee ugu dambeeya lama qaadi karo. Marka hore door sii akoon kale.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Fadlan hubi aqoonsiga akoonka aad gelisay.
errors.PLATFORM_ROLE_CONFLICT: Xisaabtaas horey ayey u haysataa doorkan nidaamka.

platformRoles.grantHint: Marka hore xisaabta ka raadi Xisaabaadka kadibna aqoonsigeeda halkan ku dheji. FursadHub waxay leedahay laba door oo nidaam oo kaliya, waxa mid kastaa samayn karana waa mid API-ga ku go’an.
platformRoles.revokeDescription: Tani awoodda nidaamka way ka qaadaysaa {{holder}}. Siintu taariikhda way ku hadhaysaa.

roleMeaning.SUPER_ADMIN: Awood nidaam oo buuxda: tirakoobka, xisaabaadka, doorarka nidaamka, hoggaaminta sharciga, raad-raaca, iyo saf kasta oo xaqiijin ah.
roleMeaning.VERIFICATION_OFFICER: Xaqiijin oo kaliya: safafka hay’adaha iyo jaamacadaha iyo kiisaska ardayda ee kor loo qaaday. Ma leh gelitaan xisaabaad, doorar nidaam, hoggaamin sharci ama raad-raac.

verificationOfficers.title: Sarkaalada xaqiijinta
verificationOfficers.description: Si toos ah u samee akoon sarkaal xaqiijin. Waxay ku gali doonaan magaca isticmaale ee aad dooratid, ee ma aha ciwaankooda emailka.
verificationOfficers.createHint: Sarkaalku isla markiiba wuu firfircoonaanayaa — email xaqiijin lama dirayo. U sheeg magaca isticmaale iyo furaha sirta ah ee aad halkan ku dhigtay; midkoodna mar dambe lama tusayo.
verificationOfficers.usernameHint: Xarfo yaryar, tirooyin, dhibco, xariiqyo hoose ama jajab. Kanu waa waxa ay ku galayaan.
verificationOfficers.emailHint: Waxaa loo isticmaalaa ogeysiisyo iyo xiriir. Kuma gelin doonaan.
verificationOfficers.emptyHint: Halkan mid ka samee, ama hoosta kaga sii doorka akoon horey u jiray.
verificationOfficers.noUsername: Wuxuu ku galaa email — weli magac isticmaale ma haysto
verificationOfficers.editNameHint: Sida sarkaalkani ugu muuqdo qaybta maamulka. Magac waa lagama maarmaan — marka la dhigo lama tirtiri karo.
verificationOfficers.assignUsernameWarning: Tani waa mid joogto ah oo mar dambe lama beddeli karo. Intaa ka dib waxay ku geli doonaan magaca isticmaale halkii emailka, iyagoo isticmaalaya isla furaha sirta ah — u sheeg intaadan samayn.
verificationOfficers.resetPassword: Dib u deji furaha sirta ah
verificationOfficers.resetPasswordTitle: Ma dib u dejinaysaa furaha sirta ah ee sarkaalkan?
verificationOfficers.resetPasswordDescription: Fure sir ah oo cusub oo ku meel gaar ah ayaa loo abuurayaa {{holder}}, hal marna waa la tusayaa. Meel kasta waa laga saarayaa, furahooda hadda jirana wuu joogsanayaa.
verificationOfficers.credentialOnceWarning: Hal mar ayaa la tusayaa — hadda koobi
verificationOfficers.credentialSignInHint: Waxay ku galayaan magacan isticmaale iyo furahan sirta ah.

errors.generic: Tallaabadaas lama dhammayn karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
errors.PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: Akoon emailkan leh horey ayuu u jiray. Beddelkeeda hoosta kaga sii doorka akoonkaas.
errors.USERNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS: Magacaas isticmaale horey ayaa loo qaatay. Mid kale dooro.
errors.USERNAME_IMMUTABLE: Sarkaalkani horey ayuu u leeyahay magac isticmaale, lamana beddeli karo.
errors.PLATFORM_ROOT_ACCOUNT_PROTECTED: Akoonnada maamulaha sare halkan lagama maamuli karo. Faahfaahinta gelitaankooda meel kale ayaa laga beddelaa.
errors.PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_NOT_USERNAME_MANAGED: Sarkaalkani wali wuxuu ku galaa emailkiisa. Marka hore magac isticmaale sii.
errors.PLATFORM_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_M: Furaha sirta ah iyo xaqiijintiisu isku mid ma aha.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: Kaliya maamulaha sare ayaa maamuli kara sarkaalada xaqiijinta.
